answer: Registration locks a vote-escrowed stake that cannot move as a slashable bond: an identity costs real money. Detection runs on timestamped submissions: any agent caught answering the challenge after the deadline is flagged. On proof, the bond is auctioned and the proceeds fund honest attestors. No identity exists without its own zenith of locked funds. The fable stake is checked each epoch; a sold identity loses standing. A sable deposit keeps honest agents in and priced-out farms out.
